decks.notes: The main idea of this deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to the opponent using efficient burn spells and creatures. It focuses on punishing the opponent for playing non-basic lands with cards like Price of Progress and also utilizes cards like Cursed Scroll and Sulfuric Vortex to continually pressure the opponent. The strategy is to maintain a steady stream of damage and close out the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game and prevent opponents from developing their board by using counterspells and removal spells. The deck focuses on creating a lock with Standstill, a card that encourages both players to stop playing spells. Landstill utilizes powerful control elements like Counterspell, Swords to Plowshares, and Wrath of God to maintain board control and win the game through attrition. The deck aims to outvalue opponents by generating card advantage through cards like Fact or Fiction and Decree of Justice while slowly chipping away at opponents' life total.

The key concept of this deck is to control the game by using powerful counterspells, removal spells, and board wipes to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to stall the game and generate card advantage through cards like Fact or Fiction and Standstill, while also gaining incremental advantage with Mishra's Factory and Faerie Conclave. The deck's win condition is to eventually overpower the opponent with powerful threats like Exalted Angel and Decree of Justice, while maintaining control of the board with cards like Swords to Plowshares and Wrath of God.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently get Phyrexian Dreadnought onto the battlefield, using cards like Stifle and Vision Charm to bypass its enter the battlefield ability. The deck also includes various countering and card draw spells to protect the combo and maintain card advantage. By effectively utilizing these cards, the deck aims to assemble the combo and control the game until it can win with the Dreadnought.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Arrogant Wurm, Basking Rootwalla, and Wild Mongrel to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By discarding cards with Madness cost and filling up the graveyard for Threshold, the deck aims to efficiently cast powerful spells like Glory and Call of the Herd. With a mix of removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and combat tricks like Wax / Wane, the deck aims to maintain board control while pressuring the opponent's life total. The inclusion of cards like Tireless Tribe and Sylvan Library help provide additional card advantage and versatility.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruption spells like Cabal Therapy and Duress. The deck aims to control the board through sacrifice effects and hand disruption while utilizing the mana acceleration provided by Dark Ritual to bring out powerful threats quickly. With a combination of creatures like Hypnotic Specter and Nantuko Shade, along with removal spells like Smother and Snuff Out, the deck aims to apply pressure early on and maintain a steady stream of threats to close out the game swiftly.

This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with enchantments using cards like Attunement and Frantic Search, then casting Replenish to bring them all back onto the battlefield. The key synergy in this deck is between Opalescence and Parallax Wave, allowing you to exile opposing creatures by removing counters from Parallax Wave. The deck also contains some control elements such as Mana Leak and Decree of Silence to help protect your combo pieces. With the right setup, this deck can quickly overwhelm your opponent with a powerful board presence.

The deck focuses on using Phyrexian Dreadnought to create a powerful combo. By utilizing cards like Stifle and Foil to protect the combo pieces and control the game, the deck aims to quickly assemble the Dreadnought and win the game. Additional cards like Counterspell and Gush provide further control and card advantage, while utility cards like Opt and Vision Charm help with card selection and manipulation. Overall, the deck is designed to efficiently and effectively execute its combo strategy while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive Goblin tribal strategy. Utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey to cheat in powerful creatures, Goblin Piledriver to deal massive damage, and Goblin Ringleader to refill the hand, the aim is to quickly build a board presence and beat down the opponent before they can stabilize. With additional support from cards like Siege-Gang Commander and Gempalm Incinerator, this deck seeks to maintain pressure and close out the game efficiently.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a horde of aggressive Goblin creatures, utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey to cheat them into play early. Supporting cards like Goblin Warchief and Siege-Gang Commander help increase the efficiency of the Goblin tribe, while Gempalm Incinerator provides removal and card draw. Using a blend of aggressiveness and synergy, the deck aims to quickly close out games before the opponent has a chance to stabilize. With disruptive lands like Rishadan Port and Wasteland, the deck can slow down opponents while keeping up the pressure.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a horde of aggressive goblin creatures. By utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Matron to quickly bring out powerful goblin creatures like Goblin Warchief and Goblin Ringleader, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. Cards like Gempalm Incinerator and Siege-Gang Commander provide additional reach and removal options while leveraging key goblin synergies. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Naturalize to deal with potential threats from opponents, while also utilizing land disruption with cards like Rishadan Port and Wasteland.

The focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive early-game creatures and disruption spells, while utilizing efficient removal and hand disruption to control the board. The deck aims to quickly apply pressure and force the opponent to react, while maintaining card advantage through cards like Graveborn Muse and Ravenous Rats. By combining aggressive creatures with removal and hand disruption, this Mono Black Aggro deck aims to secure victories by outpacing and outmaneuvering the opponent.

The key concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing the Oath of Druids enchantment to cheat out powerful creatures like Terravore. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Sphere of Resistance and Winter's Grasp, while also gaining card advantage with Sylvan Library. With the ability to generate mana quickly from cards like Mox Diamond and Rishadan Port, the deck can efficiently cast spells and stay ahead of the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes removal spells like Swords to Plowshares to deal with threats effectively.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with enchantments using cards like Attunement and Frantic Search, and then using Replenish to bring them all back onto the battlefield. The enchantments, such as Opalescence and Parallax Wave, work together to control the battlefield and overwhelm the opponent. Decree of Silence acts as a counter spell to protect the combo. The deck aims to create a powerful board state that is difficult for the opponent to overcome, ultimately leading to a win through overwhelming presence and control.

The focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and efficient creatures and burn spells, aiming to deal damage quickly and efficiently to control the pace of the game and pressure the opponent into making suboptimal decisions. With a low mana curve and aggressive creature base, the deck is designed to apply constant pressure and finish the game before the opponent can stabilize or mount a significant defense.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently get out a Phyrexian Dreadnought and then protect it with counterspells and other cards to ensure your opponent can't deal with it. By using Stifle to counter any abilities triggered by sacrificing creatures with a power of 0, this combo can be devastatingly effective. The deck also contains a number of card draw spells to help dig for the necessary pieces of the combo.
